description.value:
These grids surround important objects or protects corridors with webs of bright lasers. With 10 minutes of work, one laser grid can be installed to cover an area up to 30 feet wide and up to 30 feet high. Additional laser grids of the same type can be combined to expand their coverage. A laser grid can be set to emit invisible beams, requiring a successful @Check[perception|dc:34] check to detect them if a creature isn't already aware of the lasers. Reduce the Perception DC to [[/act seek]] an invisible laser grid by 5 in the presence of fog, mist, smoke, or other particulates. If there's no external power source, each laser grid takes a battery of the same grade or higher and uses 5 charges when triggered (or 1 charge if it only sounds an alarm).

Activate—Broken Beam r

Trigger A creature or object crosses the laser beam between two emitters, breaking it

Effect An alarm signal is activated, it deals @Damage[(3d10+6)[slashing],(4d10+6)[fire]] damage, @Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save;

Disable@Check[thievery|dc:36].
